title: metamodel-submodelChangeEventCompact.v1
description: Compact metamodel-aligned schema for Submodel change events. Minimal fields with semanticId as AAS Reference object (IDTA-01001).

Key.description: A single key within a Reference chain. Corresponds to Key in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001).

type.description: The model element type this key refers to.

value.description: The identifier or local ID of the referenced element.

Reference.description: A Reference as defined in the AAS metamodel (IDTA-01001).

type.description: Distinguishes between external references and model-internal references.

submodelId.description: Identifier of the submodel (URI). Corresponds to Submodel.id in the AAS metamodel.

semanticId.description: Semantic ID of the submodel as an AAS Reference object. Typically an ExternalReference with a GlobalReference key pointing to the IRI of the submodel template. Optional, matching Submodel.semanticId cardinality 0..1: the field is omitted when the submodel carries no semantic ID.
